goals: Maintain one Fabric mod, source tree, build, version, and deployable JAR for the absorbed Nibaru native material catalog and all BGE geometry.
Preserve every former Nibaru and BGE registry/resource identity, specialized material behavior, and saved-world reference while CNM remains an unchanged external dependency.
Expose one deterministic ordered geometry catalog for Vertical Slab, Step, Corner, Quarter Column, and Layer without changing established placement, economy, or material-frame semantics.

Offer complete nine-role BGE geometry families for the exact 79 requested optional-provider sources when Ribbits, Mynx Trees, Macaw's Paths, or Building But Better supplies the corresponding source block, and bind any BGE-only CNM candidate only after CNM itself admits its real horizontal source and resolves its actual ShapeMap graph.

Treat adding a normal catalog material as full membership in the canonical block, horizontal slab, stair, wall, Vertical Slab, Step, Layer, Corner, and Quarter Column roles unless an exact technical exclusion is recorded.
Keep canonical material identity separate from geometry generation so limited special forms such as Farmland Slab remain explicitly canonical-bound without implying a full generated family.
Require every BGE-owned registered block to have one explicit canonical classification or a documented exemption, with bootstrap validation preventing anonymous material-semantic holes.

Expose each valid binding's rendered surface as deterministic canonical-face patches with exact sixteenth planes, in-plane footprints, and explicitly typed terrain-height relationships for material-agnostic consumers.
scope: Compile the retained `games.twinhead.moreslabsstairsandwalls` source and `more_slabs_stairs_and_walls` resources directly inside BGE with a clear LGPL-covered source and attribution boundary.
Register native slabs, stairs, walls, material profiles, transitions, and client bindings before deriving CNM/BGE geometry through one guarded bootstrap and one root Fabric descriptor.

Preserve all native material profiles, canonical parents, copied settings, TOP/SIDE/BOTTOM roles, axes, patterns, tint, translucency, transitions, drops, and specialized behaviors; C62 corrects the wall-material, canonical-role duplication, leaf-wall, and plain-Path seams demonstrated by exact C61 runtime evidence, C63 corrects external axis-family inventory previews, C64 adds the complete BBB beam catalog, C65 corrects its demonstrated BBB production axis-resource classification failure, C66 gives compatible Quarter Columns Step-equivalent full-cell continuation targeting without changing their physical geometry, C68 preserves one-to-one texel density for axis-material Layer faces without changing their geometry or grain orientation, C69 restores independent material axes to the canonical BBB Beam Slab and Beam Stair, C70 restores vanilla Stone slab ownership, C71 mirrors Minecraft 26.2 horizontal-slab tilling and Farmland lifecycle semantics, C72 extends that Farmland Slab water search exactly one block lower without changing the C71 lifecycle, C73 establishes authoritative typed canonical bindings plus placement-time canonicalization for completed ordinary horizontal and Vertical Slabs, C74 adds Ribbits huge-toadstool material surfaces, C75 adds the generic binding-owned surface-patch contract, C76 makes every visible generated Ribbits toadstool surface use its assigned source-block texture, C77 canonicalizes a newly completed four-Layer blockspace while retaining legacy four-Layer states, C78 completes the contract for every resolved Stair and Wall state with authoritative union-tiled surfaces, and C79 adds three current Minecraft parent families plus a generic, resource-contract-verified CNM axis-pillar bridge.

Generate one Layer, Corner, and Quarter Column per supported canonical family while preserving Vertical Slab and Step, deterministic selector order, one-source economy, orientation, waterlogging, collision, and drops.

Provide primary Fabric ID `cnm_terrain_slabs_compat` and verified legacy alias `more_slabs_stairs_and_walls` from the same mod container and shared version `4.2.25-bge.canary81.cnm-resolved-family+26.2`.

Preserve C58 native registry/resource identities while exposing one canonical nine-role family per exact optional source variant: 52 Macaw patterned full blocks, five distinct Macaw soil Path blocks, Ribbits Mossy Oak Planks plus Red Toadstool, Brown Toadstool, and Toadstool Stem, six Mynx Trees log, wood, and leaf sources, and all 12 BBB beam parents including Pale Oak. The three Ribbits toadstools remain distinct source identities; every exposed face of each generated BGE role uses that source's assigned exterior texture, with no generated `toadstool_inside` route and no provider texture bytes included. BBB's original slab and stair registrations remain untouched, but their provider state is geometry-only and cannot carry an independent material AXIS; C69 therefore gives BGE canonical AxisSlab and AxisStairs forms, retains BBB's ordinary thin WoodenWallBlock as the canonical wall, and keeps the five other BGE axis-aware roles. C65 accepts BBB's real semantically equivalent `axis=z` `x=90,y=180` representation while rejecting unknown transforms and `uvlock`.

exclusions: Clutter No More source and artifacts remain external and unchanged; its ShapeMap remains the canonical family and switching mechanism.
C58 is limited to the user-authored glass-Corner geometry/UV route; generic glass Quarter Column projection and all non-glass Corner outputs remain C57-equivalent.

C68 changes only normal axis-material Layer face UV rectangles: it preserves Layer bounds, placement, collision, state, texture roles, grain rotation, special visual paths, non-axis materials, all other geometries, registration, data, display transforms, and external-material support.
`projects/bge-ctm`, shaders, resource-pack classification, BBB source/assets, and unrelated consumer projects are outside this consolidation.
Accepted BGE C52 and historical standalone Nibaru C45 are preserved as rollback provenance and are not rewritten.

C72 owns only the C71 Farmland Slab hydration search extension from Y..Y+1 to Y-1..Y+1; hoe conversion, moisture range/progression, rain, drying, crop retention, survival, trampling, Dirt-slab reversion, geometry, drops, waterlogging, Dirt Path, non-farmland geometry, and C70 Stone behavior remain unchanged. Crop placement, crop growth, partial-height projection, targeting, particles, and rendering remain deferred to Slab Decorations.

C73 changes canonical material classification, state projection, and the already-legal BlockItem placement result only for completed normal-catalog horizontal and Vertical Slabs. It adds no recipe, refund, migration, or broader occupancy normalization; historical double states remain valid, and special Farmland Slab is explicitly excluded from canonical full-block replacement.

C75 introduced the BGE-owned surface contract; C78 now supplies authoritative resolved-state surfaces for every ordinary Stair and Wall configuration. The contract still does not decide CTM rules, connect materials, or render overlays.

C76 changes only generated Ribbits Red Toadstool, Brown Toadstool, and Toadstool Stem texture selection plus the human-facing BGE Canary filename. Provider-owned source-block rendering, every non-toadstool family, geometry, economy, behavior, canonical identity, and the C75 surface-semantics API remain unchanged.

C77 changes only successful placement of the fourth matching normal-catalog Layer and the legacy four-Layer fallback model for uniform-textured HugeMushroomBlock providers. Layers one through three, failed or incompatible placement, legacy four-Layer state validity, recipes, drops, family identities, C75 surface semantics, C76 generated toadstool texture semantics, and provider-owned canonical source-block rendering remain unchanged.

C78 changes only binding-owned surface descriptions for resolved Stair and Wall state plus their validation. It adds no CTM or rendering policy, changes no block registration, state, collision, placement, economy, resource model, material identity, or consumer-specific rule, and leaves `projects/bge-ctm` untouched.

C79 adds normal BGE families for `minecraft:chiseled_resin_bricks`, `minecraft:chiseled_cinnabar`, and axis-aware `minecraft:purpur_pillar`; regular walls remain ordinary no-AXIS WallBlocks. C80 removes C79's registry-wide external axis scanner and uses stock CNM as an external dependency. C81 separates preregistration from family identity: it records real CNM admissions, preregisters inert BGE tail candidates without inventing a parent, then uses CNM's actual resolved ShapeMap component to bind or discard them and completes every known BGE profile in that same component. Existing provider ownership, block/item semantics, economy, CTM, and unverified resources remain unchanged.

The verified exact-C80 owner observations are recorded narrowly in project controls and do not transfer to C81, which remains ACTIVE and runtime-untested; accepted C70 and rollback C72 are unchanged.
